outcome: Maternal complications (preterm delivery rates, maternal hospital stay, maternal hemorrhage, maternal composite outcome)
cohort: The study included 161 singleton and 77 twin pregnancies, all complicated by preeclampsia.
finding: Maternal complications were more frequent in twin pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia, while neonatal complications were more likely to occur in cases of preterm preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not associated with the maternal composite outcome.
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks) and term (>=37 weeks) deliveries were included and stratified.
